data.body:
Review (page checked against liquid/BRANDING.md acceptance criteria, rendered in headless Chrome):

Verified by rendering:
- CSS survives build.js's scoping transform cleanly (ran transformCss on liquid/style.css in isolation: 493 lines, every selector scoped to #site-liquid, no unscoped leftovers).
- No horizontal overflow: measured body scrollWidth == clientWidth at 320 / 390 / 430 px (headless Chrome clamps its own window to 500px min, so widths were measured in fixed-width iframes).
- Desktop 1280x860 and narrow renders both composed; screenshots reviewed.

Defects found and fixed during implementation:
1. build.js's statement splitter cut the Google Fonts @import in half — its URL contained a raw ';' between weights. Encoded as %3B. Promoted to root CLAUDE.md as a contract rule.
2. 'software developer' rendered Mercury-on-Mercury (1:1) where a metaball drifted under it. Fixed structurally: pool repositioned to the upper right, plus a blurred dark radial behind .hero that guarantees the seating regardless of drift.
3. Oil slick at 0.35 / 78vmax washed the lower half green-magenta, breaking 'the page is blue'. Reduced to 0.16 / 56vmax.
4. The goo filter's trailing feBlend re-composited SourceGraphic over the fused silhouette, leaving visible seams between blobs. Removed — the blobs now read as one liquid mass.

Brief compliance: all seven section-3 surfaces present; three blur rungs (film/glass/deep + bloom); one light source; no border shorthand, no radius under --r-min, no straight dividers, no position: fixed; all SVG ids and keyframes prefixed liquid-; prefers-reduced-motion block present and its static state is the composed frame.

Scope note: built as index.html + style.css + script.js per CLAUDE.md's authoring contract (build.js hard-fails on a missing style.css) rather than the brand-page skill's single-file convention. liquid is deliberately NOT mapped in sites.config.json, so the root index.html is untouched and the build output is unchanged.
